pages.text: $(l)Heat$()$(br)Heat is the sum of every heater $(item)directly under the vat$():

$(li)a burning $(item)Firebox$() block gives $(item)2$(),$(li)a lit $(item)Blaze Burner$() gives $(item)1$(), or $(item)2$() when superheated,$(li)each working $(item)Freezer$() attached to the vat takes $(item)1$() away.
Heated vat recipes ask for $(item)heat 2$(): one burning firebox under the vat is enough. Remember that a compressor or freezer placed underneath takes a spot a heater could use.

$(l)Pressure$()$(br)Each running $(item)Compressor$() adds $(item)1$() pressure. Turn its shaft the other way and it removes 1 instead (goggles say Pressurizing or Depressurizing). Pressure recipes ask for $(item)pressure 1$(), so one compressor turning the right way does it.
Goggles show the vat's $(item)Heat$() and $(item)Pressure$() as bars, so you can check both before blaming the recipe.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
